newQuestion.name: Borrower category · current BCG matrix
newQuestion.description: Current governed V3 BCG Matrix quadrant for the selected borrower. Emoji provides a visual cue while retaining the exact category label. Outside active cohort remains explicit. Ignores Detail activity dates.

native.query:
WITH chosen AS (SELECT borrower_id FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
) SELECT CASE m.quadrant
 WHEN 'Cash Cow' THEN '🐄 Cash Cow' WHEN 'Dog' THEN '🐕 Dog'
 WHEN 'Star' THEN '⭐ Star' WHEN 'Question Mark' THEN '❓ Question Mark'
 ELSE coalesce(m.quadrant,'Outside active cohort') END AS "Borrower category"
 FROM chosen c LEFT JOIN public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m USING(borrower_id)

axisTitle.reason: Metabase scatter ignored title_enabled=false and displayed the dimension name; a blank explicit title preserves seven date labels.
